item.group_name: Composed pieces (several tools, one finished thing)
item.title: Choose My Thumbnail Headline

turns.text: Make a 16:9 YouTube thumbnail for my video about quitting late-night scrolling and sleeping better. Invent a tired-looking person for it and choose a punchy three-word headline yourself. Big face, easy to read on a phone.

item.tests: Tests choosing suitable unspecified headline wording and delivering a complete face-and-text thumbnail without unnecessary clarification.

answer_sheet.Video topic: Quitting late-night scrolling to sleep better.
answer_sheet.Person: Invent a tired-looking person; age, appearance and placement are your call.
answer_sheet.Platform and size: One 16:9 YouTube thumbnail; free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: One finished 16:9 thumbnail with a large, visibly tired-looking human face.
A completed headline of exactly three words appears in the image, not placeholder text.
The headline clearly relates to stopping late-night scrolling or improving sleep.
The headline is high-contrast and readable at phone-thumbnail size.
The face and headline remain unobstructed, with neither cropped awkwardly at the image edges.

turns.text: Can you make a thumbnail for my video about quitting late-night scrolling and sleeping better? This is a habit I've struggled with myself, so the topic feels pretty personal to me. I mean one 16:9 YouTube thumbnail, and I'd like you to choose a punchy headline that's exactly three words in English. Please invent a tired-looking person for it, with their age, appearance and placement up to you, but make the face big. I'm a little worried about it getting lost among all the other thumbnails people see. Make it easy to read on a phone; the style, colours and layout are your call, and free-tier resolution is fine.
turns.agent:
I couldn’t generate the thumbnail because your Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. No image was created.

Here’s the design I chose:
- **Headline:** “STOP SCROLLING TONIGHT” — exactly three English words.
- **Left:** A large, fictional tired-looking adult face, lit blue by a phone.
- **Right:** Huge stacked yellow-and-white lettering against midnight navy.
- **Finishing touch:** A red slash over the phone and a subtle warm glow suggesting better sleep.

The large face, minimal clutter, and strong contrast are designed to stand out and stay readable on a phone.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Create one polished, attention-grabbing 16:9 YouTube thumbnail about quitting late-night phone scrolling and sleeping better. Designed for instant readability on a small phone screen. EXACT headline, three English words only: "STOP SCROLLING TONIGHT". No other text, labels, logos or watermark. Layout: left 45 percent is an enormous close-up face of an entirely fictional adult around 32, short tousled dark hair, natural under-eye bags, tired heavy eyelids and an emotionally relatable exhausted expression, looking toward the viewer. Face fills almost the full height, with expressive eyes clearly visible; show a glowing smartphone near the lower-left edge illuminating the face with cold blue light. Not based on a real person. Right 55 percent holds the headline in huge extra-bold condensed sans serif lettering on three stacked lines: STOP / SCROLLING / TONIGHT. Make all words correctly spelled, exceptionally legible, clean, with thick dark outline and strong contrast. STOP and TONIGHT bright warm yellow, SCROLLING white. Keep safe generous margins, no text over face. Background deep midnight navy and nearly black, minimal bedroom hints, a subtle warm amber glow at far right suggesting restful sleep. A simple vivid red prohibition slash over the phone communicates breaking the scrolling habit. Striking blue versus amber complementary lighting, premium photographic cutout with crisp edge separation, bold graphic composition, saturated but controlled colours, strong hierarchy, very minimal clutter, empathetic rather than shaming. Prioritize face size and large readable typography over decorative detail.
